headline: Hotel Front Desk Associate
summary: Hospitality management graduate with a year at the front desk of a hot-spring resort hotel in Laguna. I check guests in and out, manage bookings from the channel manager and online travel sites, and handle requests and complaints with a smile. I want to grow into front office supervision.

projects.name: Late check-out upsell
bullets: Suggested offering paid late check-out at the desk on Sunday mornings.
It became a steady source of extra room revenue on weekends.

projects.name: Hotel operations practicum
projects.description: Rotated through front office, housekeeping and food service at a 120-room hotel during the final year.

experience.title: Front Desk Associate
bullets: Check in and out up to 150 guests a day on weekends, including large family groups.
Manage bookings from the website and three online travel platforms and fix rate mismatches.
Handle guest requests and complaints and follow up with housekeeping and maintenance.
Settle bills and prepare the shift cash report.

experience.title: Hotel Practicum Trainee
bullets: Assisted front office staff with arrivals, departures and phone reservations.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
